scope: Same benchmark source, installed dependencies and built library; separate Node processes, one warmup and five fresh fixtures per scenario. Normal timings precede profiles. Both cold operations and idle ticks retained. Node CPU evidence, not browser latency or GPU FPS.
limits: All four maxima still exceed 1000/120 ms; fire P99 increased in this run. Same-tick terrain generation, periodic burn settlement and cold avoidance remain optimization targets. Stage timings include probe overhead.

replay.scope: Node CPU only; expiry setup and snapshot structured clone excluded; render roundtrip uses synchronous structuredClone, not browser scheduling or GPU; copy kernels do not compact the protocol.

context.timing: one warmup, five fresh fixtures; operation-only timings exclude setup, resets, assertions and report allocation; cold fixture operations remain included; no browser/GPU claim
context.percentiles: nearest rank; pooled from all operations, with original per-round sample ordinals retained
context.thresholds: overBudget observes the existing scenario mean budget per operation; overTickDeadline observes 1000/simulationHz. Neither is a new tail gate.
context.scopes: travel/terrain replenish health; crowded discards hits; fire starts synchronized full-capacity burn layers, then includes idle ticks; avoidance repeats the same decision with a fresh terrain cache per round
context.profiling: Separate repeated fixtures; inclusive/self synchronous method timing and GC overlap add overhead and are not throughput or speedup evidence
